extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 2.0.0: Release 2, the Premiumize extras. - Tools, Premiumize: your account (days left, fair use), Transfers (progress, retry, delete, clear finished) and My Premiumize cloud (browse, play, delete, space used). - Caching assistant: a torrent Premiumize hasn't cached can be downloaded and waited for, or downloaded in the background with a notice when it's ready. When nothing is ready, SpongeTV offers the best one. Downloads go into a SpongeTV folder in your cloud. - Tidy-up (off by default): once a day, or with Tidy up now, deletes downloads older than 7 to 90 days from the SpongeTV folder only. - A sign-in Premiumize no longer accepts is shown as such, with Sign in again. - Source Select: the details line scrolls and starts with the pack and seeds. Earlier changes: changelog.txt
